description: Separately dated supplemental sources. Imported documents, analysis data and source hashes remain authoritative only for their original snapshot.

runwayml.summary: A dated contemporary Runway track adds one measured desktop CTA alongside the older partial analysis. Official brand guidance is recorded separately and does not grant asset rights.

sources.title: Runway brand guidelines
sources.method: Public-page text via web connector; not rendered measurement
sources.scope: Brand-name and logo usage guidance, not component tokens.
findings: The page provides logo size, legibility and clear-space guidance.
Logo-pack download accepts additional guidelines and terms; no download was performed.
limitations: No asset redistribution permission is inferred. No component colors, dimensions or type metrics were measured.

sources.title: Runway current homepage text
sources.method: Public-page extracted text; no rendered browser measurement
sources.scope: Current homepage navigation and action structure.
findings: Extracted navigation and a primary trial action are present.
limitations: Desktop/mobile layout, colors, typography, hover/focus and animation remain unknown.

sources.title: Runway desktop CTA and heading observation
sources.method: Read-only DOM getComputedStyle and getBoundingClientRect in a dedicated cloud Chromium browser. Timestamp recorded immediately after measurements.
sources.scope: Link with exact accessible name “Try Runway for free”. Default desktop state only, not official design tokens.
sources.theme: Default page presentation; light CTA and white heading
findings: Computed CTA properties: {"backgroundColor": "rgb(247, 247, 247)", "textColor": "rgb(12, 12, 12)", "fontSize": "16px", "fontWeight": "600", "lineHeight": "24px", "padding": "8px 12px", "rounded": "8px", "border": "0px solid rgb(229, 231, 235)", "height": "40px"}.
Computed font-family abcNormal, "abcNormal Fallback" is documentary only, not proof of font loading.
Measured text-dependent width 183.46875px is recorded but not copied as a universal control width.
Hero heading computed text color rgb(255, 255, 255), size 51.0478px, weight 400 and line-height 56.1526px at this viewport. Its background/assets are not reproduced.
limitations: No mobile, hover, focus, pressed or disabled observations.
Source release/version not shown. Different pages/templates/variants can explain differences from the pinned analysis; neither silently replaces the other.
No logo, imagery or font binaries copied.

specimens.title: Observed desktop CTA · default state
specimens.authored: The listed visual properties come from the dated 1180×757 desktop observation. Text, system-font substitution, semantic button markup, local click feedback, focus treatment and mobile arrangement are authored. Intrinsic source width is intentionally omitted. This is not the original component.

gaps: Only a default desktop CTA and heading were measured. Mobile layouts and interactive states remain unknown.
The original four partial recipes are unchanged; the new observation is not silently merged into the earlier snapshot.
Protected assets and fonts remain withheld.

specimens.title: Observed desktop CTA · default state
specimens.authored: The listed visual properties come from the dated 1180×757 desktop observation. Text, system-font substitution, semantic button markup, local click feedback, focus treatment and mobile arrangement are authored. Intrinsic source width is intentionally omitted. gaps: Five original numeric heights still lack explicit units; no global number-to-pixel rule is applied.
The observed homepage CTA is 42px high. The older source’s 44px primary-button example may describe a different variant or template; no equivalence is claimed.

ibm.summary: A separate official-documentation track now demonstrates Carbon Core input sizing and state semantics. These are original neutral samples, not evidence that the IBM marketing site uses the same components.

sources.title: Carbon Core text-input guidelines
sources.method: Public-page text via web connector; not rendered measurement
sources.scope: Official product-component guidance. It does not establish the version or styling of the imported ibm.com marketing snapshot.
findings: Default input sizes are 24px (xs), 32px (sm), 40px (md/default), and 48px (lg).
Default inputs place labels outside and helper text below the field.
Documented states include enabled, active, focus, error, warning, disabled, skeleton and read-only.
Invalid state uses a red border, an error icon and an error message; this source does not specify the hex color.
Text-area minimum height is documented as 40px.
sources.version: Carbon Core, Stable, React; exact release version not identified.
limitations: Full visual tokens and rendered states were not measured. Local samples use original neutral styling and system fonts.

sources.title: Carbon for IBM.com
sources.method: Public-page text via web connector; no exact retrieval clock retained
sources.scope: Website components and styling, distinct from Carbon Core product guidance.
findings: The site defines a website-specific component and layout track.
limitations: Documentation update date is historical, not a current site implementation version.

sources.title: Carbon for IBM.com extended tabs
sources.method: Earlier public-page text pass; latest connector attempt unavailable
sources.scope: Website tab guidance with explicit version distinction.
sources.version: v1 separate extended-tabs component; v2 base Carbon tabs with editorial styling.
findings: Documentation describes auto-width labels and overflow buttons when needed at any breakpoint.
limitations: No current rendered state or exact package version verified. No tab visual metrics are copied into the snapshot.

sources.title: IBM current homepage text
sources.method: Public-page extracted text; no rendered browser measurement
findings: Extracted hero has two action links followed by recommendation sections.
limitations: Not a visual or responsive-layout measurement.

sources.title: IBM homepage availability response
sources.method: Rendered page read in the dedicated cloud Chromium browser; reporting timestamp after attempt
sources.scope: Availability response only, not IBM website design evidence.
findings: The response title was “Site Unavailable” and its message was “Unable to access this site.”
limitations: Cause unverified; not labeled bot detection. No alternate access route was tried.
No IBM homepage design measurements obtained.
